summary: Silicon Valley resident, software engineer with over 25 years of experience, B.S. in Mathematics, strong advocate for open-source software and self-hosted email solutions, fluent in multiple programming languages including Java and Perl, experienced in interviewing and hiring practices, critical of modern software development practices and interview techniques, parent of a bilingual child (Finnish and French), strong opinions on property tax laws in California, nostalgic about early computing and technology, critical of corporate influence in tech, prefers vintage technology and tools, active in discussions about housing affordability and social issues in California, has lived through significant events like Hurricane Maria in Puerto Rico, and has a strong interest in astronomy and astrophotography.
